name: Waters of Xavian
summary: Deino seeks a sample from the waters of Xavian, deep in Ashenvale. The troll mage hopes to study the ancient city's lingering arcane power, and sends her apprentice to draw water from its highest waterfall.

sections.title: A Mage's Curiosity
sections.body: Deino, a troll mage in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, searches Kalimdor for traces of primal arcane energy. Her attention turns to Xavian, an ancient night elf city hidden beneath Ashenvale's eastern canopy. Scholars say the city held great magical knowledge before the Sundering. Its waters are believed to retain arcane power that modern mages hope to understand.

sections.title: The Ruins of Xavian
sections.body: Xavian lies in ruins, overrun by feral, corrupt satyrs who defend their ground from outsiders. To reach the water, you travel past Satyrnaar and through dangerous waterways, avoiding prowling beasts and demonic sentinels. Deino needs a sample from the pool at the base of the city's highest waterfall.

faq.answer: Deino is a troll mage trainer and scholar in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. She teaches Horde mages and studies relics of ancient Kalimdor magic.
Xavian is a ruined city in northeastern Ashenvale, north of Splintertree Post and northwest of Satyrnaar.

faq.q: Why does Deino want this water?
faq.answer: Deino wants to study the water's lingering arcane power. Scholars say Xavian held great magical knowledge, and she needs a fresh sample from the waterfall's source to examine its properties.

faq.q: What dangers guard the ruins of Xavian?
faq.answer: Satyrs overrun Xavian. These demonic, corrupted beings despise trespassers and guard their territory against intruders.

faq.q: Where exactly is the water sample collected?
faq.answer: You collect the sample from the pool at the base of Xavian's highest waterfall and place it in Deino's flask.

faq.q: What comes next after returning the sample to Deino?
aliases: next quest after waters of xavian
faq.answer: After you return the sample, Deino sends you to study the dryads in Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a Horde mage, you study arcane reagents by venturing into hostile wilderness to collect them.
As a member of the Horde, you can use Splintertree Post as the nearest staging ground in eastern Ashenvale before traveling through the satyr-infested wilds around Xavian.
